textos.texto: Ana is a student. She studies and she works in an office two days a week. Her boss is very kind. Her father is an engineer and he works in a big company in Peru. Her mother is a nurse. Ana has an uncle. He is a cook, and her aunt is a teacher. Laura is a programmer. Paul is a doctor. He is not a student now. What is your job? Ana asks. I am a waiter, says her friend, but I want to be a lawyer.

preguntas.enunciado: ¿Cuál es el trabajo de la madre de Ana?
Ana trabaja en una oficina dos días por semana.
Ana gana mucho dinero en su trabajo.
¿Qué quiere ser el amigo de Ana?
